definitions.A_no_memory: each turn interpreted alone (fresh session, current utterance only)
definitions.B_full_transcript: each turn: a fresh session over the concatenated transcript so far
definitions.C_structured: the adaptive session (frames, needs, constraints, evidence, claims)
definitions.context_tokens: tokens of the conversation context the arm carries (A: the utterance; B: the transcript; C: structured needs / constraints / entities of the active frame), measured with the bge-small WordPiece tokenizer as a proxy (the Phase 7 generator's tokenizer is not known)
